svg.text: yolov8n.pt - imgsz 640 x 640 - C2f backbone + SPPF - PAN neck - 3-scale anchor-free heads - 8400 predictions
One 3x3 conv layer, close up - a kernel is a tiny neuron bank
stride s = 1 - padding p = 1 - one input channel shown for clarity
same shape - one value per position
sum over the receptive field, across every input channel
one kernel is reused at every spatial position -
3x3 -> 5x5 -> 7x7 ... each conv widens what a head
neuron sees: P5 sees whole objects, P3 keeps edges.
